# Methods that receive narrow floats and compute wider ones, or stay narrow, for the `float-widening` rule.
global SCALE::Float64 = 2.0
scaled(x::Float32) = x * 2.0
halved(x::Float32) = x * 0.5f0
ratio(n::Int, m::Int, x::Float32) = x + n / m
floated(n::Int, x::Float16) = x + float(n)
global_scaled(x::Float32) = x * SCALE
elementwise(values::Vector{Float32}) = first(values) * 2.0
chained(x::Float32) = (y = x * 2.0;
    y + 1)
@noinline widened(x::Float32) = Float64(x)
calls_widened(x::Float32) = widened(x) + 1
branchy(x::Float32, flag::Bool) = flag ? x : 0.0
function merged(x::Float32, flag::Bool)
    y = flag ? x : 0.0
    return (y, flag)
end
refined(x::Float32, y::Union{Nothing, Float32}) = isnothing(y) ? x : y + x
thrower(x::Float32) = error("no float here")
wide(x::Float64) = x * 2.0
no_floats(n::Int) = n / 2

grow(x::Float32) = Float64(x)
grow(x::Int8) = x
grow(x::Int16) = x
grow(x::Int32) = x
keep(x::Float32) = x
keep(x::Int8) = x
keep(x::Int16) = x
keep(x::Int32) = x
grown(x::Float32, items::Vector{Any}) = grow(first(items))
kept(x::Float32, items::Vector{Any}) = keep(first(items))
signed_only(x::Float32, items::Vector{Signed}) = keep(first(items))
